title: A note or a drawing
intro: A short message your partner gets when they open the app. No counting, no pressure.
noteHint: E.g. good luck at today's meeting
emptyDrawing: Draw something to be able to send it.
widgetText: It only shows if your partner allows notes on their widget. Otherwise they see it only inside the app.
emptyText: When you send a note or a drawing, it shows up here.
